companies.sub: パイプライン・ターミナル

relations.text: テキサス・シティの輸出ターミナル合弁を、ONEOKと折半で所有する
relations.text_en: Texas City Logistics is owned 50% by ONEOK and 50% by MPLX LP

source.label: ONEOK 10-K(December 31, 2025)
source.quote: Texas City Logistics, the export terminal joint venture, is owned 50% by us and 50% by MPLX LP, with MPLX LP constructing and operating the facility.

relations.text: ホワイトウォーター等とEiger Expressパイプラインを発表した
relations.text_en: ONEOK, WhiteWater, MPLX LP and Enbridge announced the 450-mile Eiger Express Pipeline

source.label: ONEOK 10-K(December 31, 2025)
source.quote: In 2025, we, WhiteWater, MPLX LP and Enbridge Inc., through the existing Matterhorn joint venture, announced the new approximately 450-mile, 48-inch Eiger Express Pipeline, designed to transport up to approximately 3.7 Bcf/d of natural gas from the Permian Basin to Katy, Texas.

relations.text: Matterhorn合弁を通じ、Eiger Expressパイプラインを共同で発表した
relations.text_en: Enbridge joined ONEOK in announcing the 450-mile Eiger Express Pipeline through the Matterhorn joint venture

source.label: ONEOK 10-K(December 31, 2025)
source.quote: In 2025, we, WhiteWater, MPLX LP and Enbridge Inc., through the existing Matterhorn joint venture, announced the new approximately 450-mile, 48-inch Eiger Express Pipeline, designed to transport up to approximately 3.7 Bcf/d of natural gas from the Permian Basin to Katy, Texas.
